entry.description: `NDC`, `MDC` and their members are hidden from IntelliSense with `[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]`, so new code is steered to `ThreadContext.Stacks` and `ThreadContext.Properties`. Existing callers compile as before, without obsolete warnings, and the API reference keeps their pages (raised by @fluffynuts, implemented by @FreeAndNil)
